content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Wichita

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate degree, or equivalent) and have completed the required contact hours in project management education. No prior work experience is necessary—CAPM welcomes career changers and early-stage professionals entering Wichita's growing aerospace and manufacturing sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses the required education into a focused schedule, allowing you to balance certification training with your current role while staying connected to Wichita's professional community.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with the Project Management Institute and pay the examination fee once your contact hours are documented. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process to ensure all eligibility requirements are properly submitted to PMI.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Take advantage of Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and study materials tailored to the CAPM body of knowledge. Schedule your proctored examination when you feel confident in your readiness to test.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your credential, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or knowledge-sharing activities. Continuous learning keeps your certification current and demonstrates your dedication to the profession.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
